project.name: PublicGex observational envelopes, pressure, and exhaustion
project.scope: Observational research release only; no decision scoring or NinjaTrader payload changes. The linked plan defines formulas, edge cases, configuration, and release gates.

tasks.title: Freeze legacy outputs and define research contracts
tasks.goal: Establish testable compatibility boundaries and shared feature contracts before analytical changes.
subgoals: Read AGENTS.md, the implementation plan, and the source proposal; preserve the independent workspace, Lightweight Charts requirement, read-only broker behavior, Tauri lifecycle, port 5010, and demo isolation.

Capture deterministic fixtures for scenario/regime/bias/target/invalidation, execution candidates, NinjaTrader schema-v2 numerical fields, default Gamma Sweep, and oi_activity_v1 positioning using existing backend tests.

Define versioned envelope, pressure, exhaustion, coverage, configuration, availability-time, and nullable-field fixture contracts in backend/tests and src/api.test.ts; accept absent new frontend fields but reject malformed present fields.
Document the plan's option_research defaults, clock policy, observed-minute semantics, causal cutoff rules, and no-signal-integration boundary in fixture expectations.
Run the existing baseline build, TypeScript, Python, and browser checks; record pre-existing failures without rewriting expected analytical results.
verify_complete: Identical legacy fixtures have explicit saved expected outputs that subsequent tasks can compare.
Research fixture examples distinguish absent, unavailable, partial, measured zero, warmup, and usable values.
Baseline check results and any existing failures are recorded; no application behavior or original-app runtime resources are changed.

tasks.title: Extract interval mechanics and load causal session observations
tasks.goal: Provide a reusable read-only observation layer without changing existing positioning values.
subgoals: Add backend/observation_intervals.py for identity, finite values, ordered snapshot adjacency, duplicate exclusion, bounded gaps, and cumulative-volume validation; refactor backend/positioning.py without changing current-universe/current-gamma semantics.

Add backend/research_observations.py with batched symbol/session reads through explicit timestamp and snapshot-ID cutoffs, including empty snapshot headers, every poll, all observed expirations, zero-OI contracts, quote fields, and spot samples.
Keep legacy positive-OI and minute-selected TRACE queries intact; do not repurpose load_positioning's 15-minute/current-expiry reader as full-session pressure history.

Implement the plan's observation_timezone and quote-clock normalization; verify provider-to-storage serialization with collector fixtures. Treat unestablished timestamp provenance, DST ambiguity, and invalid times as unavailable with reason counts.

Add backend/tests/test_observation_intervals.py and test_research_observations.py; extend test_positioning.py and collector fixtures for adjacent missing observations, duplicates, volume resets, equal times, 120-second limits, session changes, and future cutoff exclusions.
verify_complete: All existing positioning fixture values and default status/coverage semantics remain unchanged.
A disappearing contract contributes only during valid adjacent observations and cannot be bridged or removed retroactively based on a later universe.
Reader supports sqlite3 and application SQLAlchemy connections without writes, ORM initialization, collector imports, or per-contract queries.
Local collection clocks and UTC/offset quote clocks compare correctly in known fixtures; uncertain clocks produce explicit exclusions.

tasks.title: Implement envelopes and backend payloads
tasks.goal: Return deterministic Flow and Structural levels using the existing modeled zero-crossing engine.
subgoals: Add backend/option_envelopes.py with call-positive/put-negative weighted gamma, absolute net-strike ranking, deterministic tie breaks, nullable levels, strengths, coverage, and boundary warnings as defined in the plan.

Extend backend/gamma_sweep.py with keyword-only weight_field defaulting to open_interest; support volume without requiring positive OI, preserve existing default output, and adapt nearest modeled crossings without extrapolation.
Integrate both modes into backend/appy.py dashboard and TRACE results and Structural mode into One-Off; keep Flow unavailable where same-session volume provenance is absent.
Return per-snapshot historical envelopes with availability bounds and separate collected/modeled ranges; exclude degenerate all-zero sweep curves from envelope zero selection.

Add backend/tests/test_option_envelopes.py and extend test_gamma_sweep.py/test_service.py for missing/zero weights, zero-OI volume, cancellation, ranking ties, multiple/no crossings, boundary flags, old data, One-Off separation, and unchanged decisions.
verify_complete: Hand-calculated signed weights, ranked levels, strength values, and nearest-crossing selections match fixtures for both modes.
Default Gamma Sweep and all legacy fixture outputs remain unchanged.
Historical levels use only their selected snapshot and retain nulls; RPC results never fabricate levels from the legacy flip.
No collector range, database schema, broker request, or NinjaTrader payload is changed.

tasks.title: Render envelopes across Cockpit, TRACE, and One-Off
tasks.goal: Expose source selection, historical levels, strengths, and coverage through existing chart infrastructure.
subgoals: Extend src/types.ts and src/api.ts with strict envelope contracts and absent-field compatibility; add malformed-payload coverage in src/api.test.ts.
Add src/EnvelopePanel.tsx and integrate it near Gamma Sweep in src/Cockpit.tsx and with One-Off profile rendering in src/ResearchViews.tsx/src/ProfileCharts.tsx.
Extend src/TraceCharts.tsx and appropriate existing primitives with timestamped solid Zero and broken Major/Minor levels; choose historical state by available_at rather than latest state.
Reuse src/LightweightChart.tsx and chartViewport.ts for theme, export, tooltip, resize, and retained-view behavior; represent unavailable levels as gaps.
Add src/optionResearch.test.tsx coverage for source labels, strength display, warnings, null levels, old payloads, and cursor-selected envelope state.
verify_complete: Source toggling changes only the research display and shows the correct volume/OI proxy label.
A historical TRACE cursor cannot display a future level or draw the latest level backward across the session.
One-Off displays Structural Envelopes with an honest Flow-unavailable state when appropriate.
Build and relevant frontend/API tests pass using only TradingView Lightweight Charts.

tasks.title: Calculate pressure, coverage, and session minute history
tasks.goal: Produce estimated hedge impulses and causal cumulative/EMA series with explicit missing-data semantics.
subgoals: Add backend/flow_pressure.py implementing the plan's quote freshness, last-trade interval, signed delta, spot, and aggressor checks; retain midpoint-neutral and unclassified known volume separately.
Aggregate delta shares/dollars plus four side/action buckets and optional gamma activity from every valid observation interval at its right endpoint.

Build completed one-minute points, separate provisional current-minute diagnostics, observed cumulative totals, gap-aware EMA15/EMA30, five-minute impulse/slope, and versioned coverage/status metadata.
Integrate full-session pressure into existing dashboard and TRACE RPCs without reusing or renaming existing modeled delta/charm pressure.

Add backend/tests/test_flow_pressure.py for four signs, neutral and zero flow, resets, duplicates, stale/future quotes, missing clocks/greeks, right-end bucketing, session resets, gaps, EMA warmup, classification thresholds, and append-future invariance.
verify_complete: Known-volume unknown classification stays unclassified; unknown-volume intervals are counted separately instead of assigned zero volume.
Measured zero pressure differs from missing pressure and EMA warmup; gaps never create artificial impulses or connecting points.
Cumulative values and EMA results match hand-computed minute fixtures independent of poll frequency and visible TRACE range.
The four bucket signs are correct, provisional minutes do not enter completed history, and legacy outputs stay unchanged.

tasks.title: Display pressure and synchronize TRACE research time
tasks.goal: Provide an estimated-pressure chart whose coverage, viewport, crosshair, and summaries follow the selected session and cursor.
subgoals: Add pressure types and strict validators to src/types.ts/src/api.ts, preserving nullable points, bucket diagnostics, status, availability bounds, and old-response compatibility.
Create src/PressurePanel.tsx and src/pressure.css with cumulative pressure, configured EMA lines, slope/impulse summaries, classification coverage, warnings, and the required inference disclosure.
Integrate Cockpit and a lower TRACE panel via src/Cockpit.tsx, src/ResearchViews.tsx, and src/TraceCharts.tsx using the existing LightweightChart host.

Synchronize actual visible time ranges and crosshair positions with loop guards; compute research summaries at cursor as-of and clip points by availability without resetting full-session cumulative history.
Extend frontend tests for numeric zero, null, partial data, cold starts, missing EMA values, unavailable state, retained zoom, and source/session changes.
verify_complete: The display always identifies pressure as estimated and shows classification quality alongside values.
TRACE panning and replay cannot change earlier cumulative values or expose future completed minutes.
Null intervals render as gaps; labels distinguish unknown, warming up, flat, rising, and falling.
Existing chart lifecycle and retained-view tests pass with the synchronized panel.

tasks.title: Implement causal exhaustion candidates and evidence
tasks.goal: Emit reproducible inferred side/action events using completed observed bars, trailing flow percentiles, and weakening evidence.
subgoals: Add backend/exhaustion.py to build observed minute OHLC with sample counts, enforce completed eligible price bars, and calculate inclusive five-bar 70/30 location filters.
Implement prior-60-eligible-minute bucket percentiles with 30-reference warmup, Low/Medium/High/Strong thresholds, positive-flow gate, and current classification coverage requirement.
Implement the plan's exact turn/deceleration/EMA reversal/divergence/proximity definitions, mandatory weakening evidence, weighted component score, and availability flags.
Generate stable event IDs, minute-end availability timestamps, five-minute per-bucket cooldown, separate hedge direction, nearest envelope context, and latest active Cockpit summary.

Integrate research events/status into existing dashboard and TRACE responses; add backend/tests/test_exhaustion.py for all buckets, presets, boundary values, warmup, evidence, missing samples, filter-disabled behavior, cooldown, configuration identity, and no look-ahead.
verify_complete: Each event exposes its inferred label, evidence flags, score components, quality, and observed-price source.
Envelope proximity by itself cannot emit an event; insufficient observations produce no fabricated candidate.
Adding or modifying future rows cannot change an earlier event; full-history filtered output equals prefix calculation.
Exact 70/30 thresholds and +5-minute cooldown boundaries pass deterministic tests; no scenario or signal generation changes.

tasks.title: Add exhaustion UI and persist research settings
tasks.goal: Make markers, evidence, active-state summaries, and research configuration available without disturbing existing preferences.
subgoals: Add strict exhaustion/event/config types and validators in src/types.ts/src/api.ts and backend unavailable-object contracts.
Add src/ExhaustionMarkers.ts using the existing TRACE primitive/overlay approach; render distinct four-bucket markers with evidence tooltips and accessible text, clipped to cursor availability.
Add the latest five-minute active-candidate summary in Cockpit with distinct unavailable and no-active-condition states.

Extend backend/app_settings.py and src/ManagementViews.tsx with nested option_research defaults, safe deep merging, enum/range/timezone validation, basic controls, and advanced period/threshold/timezone controls.

Include config fingerprint in calculated payloads/cache keys and invalidate research caches on settings changes; extend backend/tests/test_settings.py and frontend tests for preservation of existing preferences and correct configured labels.
verify_complete: Marker tooltip evidence matches its event data and no marker is visible before its minute-end availability.
Settings round-trip correctly, reject invalid combinations, preserve unrelated settings, and consistently recompute research output.
All four inferred side/action labels remain distinguishable without implying a trade recommendation or observed dealer identity.
Theme, tab state, source control, null handling, and baseline scenario rendering remain intact.

tasks.title: Exercise research with deterministic demo and browser workflows
tasks.goal: Verify the full UI and RPC path using synthetic observations processed by the production calculators.
subgoals: Extend backend/demo_data.py with deterministic multi-poll minute observations, valid clocks, rising and rolling pressure, upper/lower price patterns, nearby envelopes, and sufficient percentile/EMA warmup.
Include zero-OI activity, midpoint trades, missing quote fields, gaps, and reset fixtures with explicit synthetic labels; keep collector and broadcaster disabled in demo.
Add tests/e2e/option-research.spec.ts using existing chart helpers to test source toggle, coverage, pressure lines, four marker tooltips, settings, session changes, and cursor timing.
Verify full-session versus prefix replay equivalence through RPC/UI, including same-minute snapshots, a shortened visible range, and future appended observations.
Test synchronized range/crosshair, wheel zoom, drag pan, hidden-tab replay pause, fractional viewport retention, themes, resize, and PNG export with new lines/markers.
verify_complete: Both upside and downside synthetic fixtures render expected events derived by real backend calculators.
Browser replay never exposes future envelope states, pressure points, or exhaustion markers.
New and existing browser workflows pass, including unchanged displayed scenario decisions.
Demo starts without credentials, remains labeled synthetic, and cannot collect or broadcast live data.

tasks.title: Extend the read-only historical shadow evaluator
tasks.goal: Produce reproducible JSON/CSV research comparisons with chronological holdout and explicit coverage exclusions.
subgoals: Extend backend/positioning_validation.py with envelope_touch, pressure_direction, pressure_divergence, and exhaustion_reversal families while preserving legacy defaults and read-only database access.
Add --families, --output-json, and --output-csv options; include model versions, config fingerprint, session split, sample counts, clock/coverage exclusions, and optional samples.

Implement the plan's fixed 5/15/30-minute outcome definitions, nonoverlapping primary observations, common family-specific eligible samples, envelope baselines/distance buckets, and exhaustion side/action/regime/proximity segments.
Preserve earliest-80%-development/session-level holdout separation; calculate all features from a bounded prefix and keep future outcome loading separate.

Extend backend/tests/test_positioning_validation.py with missing old quote fields, insufficient sessions, frozen cutoffs, incomplete forward paths, no-write checks, matching sample populations, and JSON/CSV parity.
verify_complete: Evaluator runs on an explicitly selected app-owned or synthetic database without collector/app startup or source database writes.
Development and holdout session sets are disjoint; future observations never enter feature calculation.
Reports show coverage and comparable baseline samples; older Structural-only rows remain usable for their family.
Insufficient data is labeled honestly, and 20-session/100-candidate prerequisites do not automatically enable signals.
Exported JSON and CSV parse and represent the same report/sample values.

tasks.title: Bound research loading, caching, and replay costs
tasks.goal: Keep full-session research responsive and isolated without premature derived persistence.
subgoals: Profile ordered research queries, envelope sweeps, pressure/exhaustion scans, JSON serialization, and frontend updates using the plan's deterministic full-session five-symbol benchmark.
Use one chronological pass and batched reads instead of repeated prefix calculations; memoize per-snapshot envelopes and preserve exact cutoff results.
Implement or finalize bounded four-session/30-second research caching keyed by engine/workspace, symbol, session, final snapshot/time, versions, settings fingerprint, and relevant request window.
Verify separate One-Off/live/demo namespaces, defensive returned copies, settings invalidation, and no stale reused results after snapshot changes.
Record machine, cold/warm latency, memory, payload bytes, and query counts; optimize to the plan's budgets without changing semantics or adding an unreviewed derived-data migration.
tasks.notes: Measured on AMD Ryzen 7 2700X / 16 logical processors / 23.9 GB RAM with Node 25.8.2 and Python 3.12.6. Dashboard: 587.3 ms cold, 63.8 ms warm, 129132 bytes. TRACE: 1311.6 ms cold, 78.5 ms warm, 603205 bytes.
verify_complete: Measured one-symbol full-session payload meets <=2-second cold, <=500-ms warm, and <=10-MB JSON targets on the recorded test machine, or implementation is optimized before release.
SQL query count does not grow per contract or per minute, cache size is bounded, and full-session processing does not repeat every prefix.
Cache and uncached calculations agree for the same input/config; workspace, session, config, and One-Off changes cannot cross-contaminate results.
Causality, nullable values, and all baseline analytical fixtures remain unchanged after optimization.

tasks.title: Complete release verification and document research limits
tasks.goal: Deliver a tested research release with accurate documentation and no automatic decision or integration changes.
subgoals: Run npm run build, npm test, python -m pytest backend/tests -q (or documented npm run test:backend environment equivalent), npm run test:e2e, and npm run native:test; resolve feature regressions and record results.

For packaged release run npm run native:build, node scripts/native-ui-smoke.mjs, and .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/native-smoke.py following scripts/native-* and README; verify new Python modules and chart primitives in the frozen backend/production CSP.

Check existing lifecycle/isolation tests for automatic live startup preferences, missing credentials, occupied port 5010, shutdown, explicit RPC allowlists, and disabled demo integrations without starting a real live collector for research validation.

Update README.md and the current docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md section with research labels, clock assumption, sparse-data/warmup limitations, settings, evaluator usage, measured performance, and actual check results.
Compare all T01 legacy fixtures unchanged; document optional NinjaTrader fields and future signal integration as separate follow-up work gated by frozen holdout evidence.
tasks.notes: Passed npm run build, 85 frontend tests, 202 backend tests, 17 Playwright workflows, and 4 native Rust tests. Packaged installer and live provider/NinjaTrader checks were not run because this verification did not produce a packaged release.
verify_complete: All required build, backend, frontend, browser, and native checks pass; packaged checks are recorded if a packaged release is produced.
Existing decision outputs, execution candidates, positioning, OI Gamma Sweep, and schema-v2 numerical fields match T01 fixtures.
Envelopes, estimated pressure, and exhaustion satisfy the source proposal's observational acceptance criteria with no future-data leakage.
Documentation distinguishes completed automated checks, unperformed manual/live checks, and research hypotheses; no original-app runtime resource was accessed.
No signal integration or new NinjaTrader fields are enabled, and release completion does not require waiting for future market sessions.
